[[Madruk Dhuum]] is one of the four riders of [[Dhuum]]. These riders must be killed as part of the quest [[The Four Horsemen]].

*[[The Underworld]]
**{{NPC location|Chaos Planes}} (only during [[The Four Horsemen]])

==Notes==
*This creature has a [[miniature]] [[Miniature Madruk Dhuum|version]].

==Trivia==
* The ''Doom of Madruk'' is a term used by the Sailor in Series 5 of [[W:Sailor Moon|Sailor Moon]].
* [[W:Marduk|Marduk]] is a Sumerian patron deity of magic. It is also the name of the antagonist of the computer game [[w:Sacrifice_(computer_game)#Single-player_campaign|Sacrifice]].
